title: Agent guidance mirrors track the layered CLAUDE.md

outcomes.statement: CODEX.md, .cursorrules and .github/copilot-instructions.md always equal the fully layered CLAUDE.md, so every assistant reads the same governing guidance including the CHG-022 Work Readiness Gate.
outcomes.demo: reconcile-sprint1-docs.py rewrites all three mirrors to the layered CLAUDE.md text; sha256 equality holds across CLAUDE.md and the three mirrors, and --check passes on the reconciled tree.

uncertainties.statement: infra/scripts/reconcile-sprint1-docs.py is byte-pinned by REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 in scripts/work-readiness/git.mjs; editing it makes registeredOverlayLayers() fail closed and silently drops overlay ownership for docs/stories/**.
uncertainties.resolution: Re-pin REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 to the new reconciler digest in the same commit and record the reviewer sign-off the constant's comment requires.
